products.name: The Original Tee
products.description: An engraved dolphin, flowing acoustic lines, and the Dolphin Singularity wordmark. The original design in a classic crewneck format.

products.name: The Original Hoodie
products.description: The same dolphin artwork, scaled for the chest of a pullover hoodie. A quieter companion to the graphic tees.

products.name: The Meeting Tee
products.description: “This meeting could have been a whistle.” For everyone who has sat through a forty-minute conversation with about three seconds of useful information.

products.name: The Fluent Tee
products.description: “Fluent in EEE EEE EEE.” Excellent communication skills. Unconventional delivery. A confident little dolphin with a lot to say.

products.name: The Highly Intelligent Tee
products.description: “Highly intelligent. Still making weird noises.” Two things can be true. A cheerful tribute to complicated minds and unusual conversations.
